 ORDER

This first anticipatory bail application under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. has been filed on behalf of the applicant knocking the portal of this Court as she is apprehending her arrest in connection with Crime No.36/2022 of Police Station - Economic Offence Cell Unit, Jabalput (MP) for commission of the offences punishable under Section 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B of IPC.

entities.text: Police Station - Economic Offence Cell Unit, Jabalput
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: As per prosecution story, applicant got sanctioned a loan of Rs.16 Lacs from Bank of Baroda (the then Vijiya Bank) for purchase of a four wheeler.
Vehicle was purchased on 24.3.2017.
The vehicle was hypothecated with HDFC Bank.
No Objection Certificate of HDFC Bank was produced before RTO, Narsinghpur but later it was found that NOC was a forged and fake document.
FIR was registered and after investigation charge sheet has to be filed.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
She is innocent.
She has been falsely implicated.
Investigation is already over and charge sheet has to be filed.
As investigation has been completed, no purpose would get served by sending the applicant behind the bar.
Therefore, it has been prayed that applicant be released on anticipatory bail.

On the other hand, learned counsel for the Economic Offence Wing has opposed the grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant but has fairly admitted that investigation has already been completed and charge sheet has to be filed before the competent Court very soon.
Investigation has already been completed and in the course of investigation, applicant was not arrested.
Therefore, now no purpose would get served by sending her behind the bar after filing of charge sheet as trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the view that applicant may be released on anticipatory bail.
Consequently, this first anticipatory bail application under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant stands allowed.

It is directed that in the event of arrest applicant - Jayshree Agrawal be released on bail on her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Authority.

However, it is being made clear that in case of bail jump and in violation of any of conditions imposed herein above, this order shall become ineffective and Investigation Officer/trial Court shall be at liberty to proceed against the applicant as per law.
C.C. as per rules.
(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE mrs. mishra Jayshree Agrawal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/101161965/
